title: Covex
description:
This website is one stop info gathering platform, where the user can check 
- Token Summary
- A DEX market sentiment and socials summary
- Details of the asset pairs traded on the DEX.

Users can also check into different main nets and gather summaries of the respective tokens
how_its_made:
- Not really a problem but I ran into a bug with react-app where in `package.json` file it was expecting a homepage URL after deploying to production. 
- After hours of debugging ( and lot of tea)  found out that package expects homepage URL which matches the project name.
